intro: Sustainable agreements. Accountable government. Reliable public services.
position: Yankee Institute advocates sustainable government labor agreements, transparent negotiations and a clear accounting of long-term costs.
context: Government labor-management policy shapes public services, pension obligations and the financial choices available to Connecticut communities. Local leaders need the flexibility to respond to local fiscal conditions.

questions.title: How should government serve residents?
questions.text: Yankee Institute supports open negotiations and sustainable agreements that balance workforce needs, reliable services and the fiscal capacity of Connecticut communities.

questions.title: What do employment numbers tell us?
questions.text: Connecticut’s payroll job count and estimates of employed residents are moving in different directions. Portfolio explains the surveys’ differences and the warning signs obscured by the record payroll figure.

questions.title: Who pays for pension promises?
questions.text: The State Police overtime study examines how overtime practices affect pension obligations, and calls for extending reforms to employees covered by older rules.
